newsitem.title: USA: US late spot propane flat, Conway trade at impasse.
newsitem.headline: US late spot propane flat, Conway trade at impasse.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were flat Thursday with buyers and sellers reaching an impasse in the Conway region, while ethane climbed on short covering, players said.
Conway propane was offered at 36.50 cents a gallon, with buyers standing firm at 35.75 cents, traders said.
Mont Belvieu propane, meanwhile, was unchanged from Wednesday with offers at 35.50 cents, and a deal seen done at that level, players said.
Belvieu purity ethane was sold for 20 cents a gallon, 0.25 cent firmer than Wednesday, and Conway mix offered a half-cent firmer at 16.0 cents, players said.
